query: MATCH p = (source:"route")-["calls"|"imports"*1..4]->(target:"external_system") WHERE source.kind IN ["route","service"] AND p.depth >= 1 AND EVERY edge IN EDGES(p) SATISFIES edge.phase IN ["build","runtime","semantic"] AND edge.generated = false AND SOME evidence IN EVIDENCE(p) SATISFIES evidence.path STARTS WITH "apps/" AND evidence.ordinal >= 0 RETURN DISTINCT source.id, target.id, p ORDER BY source.id, target.id, p ASC LIMIT 200
